-- use.mms --
TemplatePool rooms {
  fallback = caps
  elements = [Piece("rooms/room", processors = rooms_decay), Piece(weight = 2, path = "rooms/vault")]
}
TemplatePool broken {
  fallback = caps
  elements = [Piece(), Piece("a", 1, minecraft:empty, 9), Piece("b", size = 3)]
}
